title: Long-running campaigns keep saving
summary: Shared campaigns no longer slowly fill up with the server's record of past actions, so they can't reach the online size limit just by being played for a long time.
items: The record that stops a retried action counting twice is now stored beside the campaign instead of inside it, and it is kept for the life of the campaign.
A campaign that had already reached the limit this way saves again on its next change, and the DM can end the session as usual.
Nothing is deleted: every past action stays protected against being applied twice.
